<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that correspond to the Peterson reaction: forward reaction breaks a carbon‑silicon bond (trimethylsilyl) and a carbon‑oxygen bond (alcohol) and forms a C=C double bond. Therefore, in the forward direction the functional groups broken are “trimethylsilyl” and “alcohol”, and the functional group formed is “C-C double bonds”. Use the target molecule SMILES provided.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "alcohol"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
